item.title: These Businesses Are Hiring
item.description: Join our fun & friendly team at Holbrook’s Clearance Center in Chico! We’re hiring a part-time salesperson for Saturdays and Sundays (9:45am-6pm). Bi-Lingual Spanish speakers is a plus! Furniture sales experience a plus! Earn $19-$23/hour + daily bonuses. Possibility to go full-time! Apply in person Monday-Friday @ 230 W East Ave, Chico
